Azeus Systems Holdings Ltd. held its annual general meeting in Singapore on July 29, 2026, in a hybrid format combining a physical venue with live webcast and audio stream via its Convene AGM platform. Shareholders further authorized the directors to allot and issue new shares and convertible securities within specified limits, including a cap of 50% of issued share capital and stricter thresholds for non–pro rata issuances.
